title: All About Vtubers: Plushies
description: Introduces VTuber Themed Plushies that you can Win through a Crane Game
body:
![Vtuber Plushies](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e69643ebe9699379b4ea2ffb3e9c8839dccf76af.png) 


A collectible-focused Minecraft mod that brings VTubers into the game as decorative plushies.Designed for VTuber Fans who enjoy collecting, showcasing, and personalizing their world with VTuber-Themed content.Build your collection, display your favorites, and create unique scenes using a growing roster of VTuber-inspired plushies.

 __Purpose__

*   Add personality and creativity to your world  
*   Celebrate VTubers inside Minecraft  
*   Encourage collection and completion gameplay 
*   Provide a platform for creators to be featured in-game  

__**Expandable**__
#
Built to support Vtubers contributions, allowing new VTubers to be added through Submissions.

 

**! THE PROJECT IS CURRENTLY IN __ALPHA__ AND IS NOT RECOMMENDED TO BE USED IN YOUR EXISTING SERVER !**
